verdict.rationale: Docs reference multiple language-specific integration guides (e.g., JavaScript source maps, external access token for Deployments/JS upload APIs) and community mentions of a .NET SDK, implying official SDKs exist for various platforms, but there is no consolidated official SDK catalog, and probes show no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt for machine-readable API access. missing for 10: a clear official SDK list/documentation page, OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent confirmation of SDK quality across languages.
